inputs.name: custom_authorization_header
inputs.label: Custom HTTP Headers for Introspection Request
inputs.description:
Add custom headers for the introspection request by adding each header's name and value with a new line
            between each header.
            Ex:
              <Header 1 Name>: <Value 1>

inputs.name: optional_introspection_request_params
inputs.label: Additional Introspection Request Parameters
inputs.description: Any additional parameters to append to the request body, separated by &. Example: 'param1=abc&param2=def'

inputs.name: standalone_received_scopes
inputs.label: Expected Introspection Response Value: scope
inputs.description: A space-separated list of scopes from the original access token response body

inputs.name: standalone_id_token
inputs.label: Access Token Response: id_token
inputs.description: The ID token from the original access token response body, IF it was present

inputs.name: standalone_patient_id
inputs.label: Expected Introspection Response for Patient Launch Context Parameter
inputs.description: The value for patient launch context from the original access token response body, IF it was present

inputs.name: standalone_encounter_id
inputs.label: Expected Introspection Response for Encounter Launch Context Parameter
inputs.description: The value for encounter launch context from the original access token response body, IF it was present

inputs.name: active_token_introspection_response_body
inputs.label: Active Token Introspection Response Body
inputs.description: The JSON body of the token introspection response when provided an ACTIVE token
